biography.ja: ナポリに生まれ、詩人カルドゥッチや音楽家チェージに学んだ。作曲だけでなく自ら台本も執筆する多才な作曲家で、実際の殺人事件から着想を得たとされる代表的な一幕物オペラで一躍名声を確立した。ピアニストとしても活動した経歴を持つ。
biography.en: Born in Naples, he studied under the poet Carducci and the musician Cesi. A versatile composer who wrote his own librettos as well as music, he established his fame at a stroke with a landmark one-act opera said to have been inspired by an actual murder case. He also had a career as a pianist.

style.ja: 現実の事件や庶民の激しい感情を写実的に描く「ヴェリズモ」オペラの様式を代表する作曲家の一人で、劇中劇という枠組みを用いて虚構と現実が交錯する構成を巧みに操った。感情の高まりを一気に爆発させる劇的な旋律線と、緊迫感のあるオーケストレーションを特徴とする。
style.en: He is one of the representative composers of verismo opera, depicting real events and the intense emotions of ordinary people with realism, and he skillfully handled a play-within-a-play structure in which fiction and reality intersect. His style is marked by dramatic melodic lines that erupt with rising emotion and tautly tensioned orchestration.

impact.ja: 代表作は同時代のマスカーニの一幕物オペラと組み合わせて上演される慣習が定着しており、両作は「カヴァ・パリ」と略称されるほど分かちがたい対の演目として今日でも世界中の歌劇場で頻繁に上演され続けている。ヴェリズモ・オペラという潮流を確立した最重要人物の一人として、マスカーニと並び称される。
impact.en: His best-known work has become established in the tradition of being staged together with his contemporary Mascagni's one-act opera, and the pairing, familiarly abbreviated as "Cav and Pag," remains frequently performed together at opera houses worldwide today. He is ranked alongside Mascagni as one of the most important figures in establishing the verismo opera movement.
